Package ke.ric.renderer.api

Record Class RenderLighting

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
ke.ric.renderer.api.RenderLighting
Record Components:
ambientFactor - multiplier for inherited ambient light, finite in 0..64
sunFactor - multiplier for inherited sunlight, finite in 0..64
blockFactor - multiplier for captured block illumination and coloured block emitters, finite in 0..64
sunDirection - world-space direction from a surface toward the sun, or null to follow rendered time
lights - copied list of immutable PointLight or SpotLight values
public record RenderLighting(double ambientFactor, double sunFactor, double blockFactor, LightDirection sunDirection, List<VirtualLight> lights) extends Record
Immutable lighting for a request or one recipe layer. Every modifier returns a new value. world() preserves the existing inherited lighting path. studio() starts with ambient, sunlight and captured block lighting disabled, ready for explicit lights.

Entity-layer selection and occlusion can restrict primary-camera output while retaining surrounding geometry for lighting and shadows. Geometry excluded by SceneContent is instead removed from all rays. Capture exclusions and viewer privacy remove evidence before it can influence rendering. Explicit lights and requested hard shadows are supported in every advertised quality profile by the matching provider.

Limits are per render pass: at most 16 virtual lights, eight casting shadows, range at most 64 blocks and factors/intensity from 0 to 64. Check RendererClient.lightingCapabilities() for the active provider. Unsupported controls or lower provider limits fail explicitly.
